senses.gloss:
विघट् {c1c} A.
1 To be disunited
or separated.
--2 To be spoiled or
ruined.
--3 To be stopped, break
down.
--4 To assume various shapes;
Māl. 9. 24. --Caus.
1 To separate,
disperse, tear apart;
विघटयंत्यग्रेनभोंऽभोमुचः Māl. 5. 2.
--2 To remove,
displace.

विघट्ट् {c10c} U.
1 To strike down,
disperse, scatter, scare away;
Śi. 1. 64; Bh. 3. 54.
--2 To rub, strike,
rub against;
कारंडवाननविघट्टितवीचिमालाः Rs. 3. 8; 4. 9; विघटृइतानां
सरलद्रुमाणां Ku. 1. 9 Ki. 8. 45; Śi. 8. 24,
13. 41.
--3 To break, violate (as an
agreement).
--4 To break asunder,
burst open (as a door).

विघट्टनं --ना
1 Striking asunder.
--2
Striking against, friction.
--3
Separating, undoing, untying.
--4
Offending, hurting.

विघटित p. p.
1 Separated,
severed.
--2 Divided.
--3 Broken,
shattered; U. 3. 43.

विघट्टित p. p.
1 Struck apart,
severed, separated, dispersed;
Bh. 3. 54.
--2 Untied, loosened, opened.
--3 Rubbed, touched.
--4 Shaken
about, churned.
--5 Hurt, offended.

विघटिका A measure of time
equal to one-sixtieth part of
a Ghaṭikā (or nearly equal
to 24 seconds).

विघट्टनं --ना
1 Striking asunder.
--2
Striking against, friction.
--3
Separating, undoing, untying.
--4
Offending, hurting.

1 A mallet, hammer.
--2
One who destroys, subdues or
overpowers.

1 Half-chewed morsel,
the residue or leavings of food
eaten; विघसो भुक्तशेषं तु Ms. 3. 285;
तृप्यत्कालकरालवक्त्रविघसव्याकीर्यमाणा
इव U. 5. 6; Māl. 5. 14.
--2 Food in
general.
--सं Bees'-wax.
--Comp.
--आशः, --आशिन् m. one who eats
the remains of an offering or of
food eaten.

1 Destruction,
removing, warding off; क्रियादवानां मघवा
विघातं Ki. 3. 52.
--2 Killing, slaying.
--3 An obstacle, impediment,
interruption; opposition, prevention;
क्रियाविघाताय कथं प्रवर्तसे R. 3. 44;
अध्वरविघातशांतये 11. 1.
--4 A blow,
stroke.
--5 Abandoning, leaving.
[]
--Comp.
--सिद्धिः f. the removal of
obstacles.

विघूर्णित p. p. Rolled, shaken
about, rolling (as eyes).

विघृष्ट p. p.
1 Rubbed
excessively.
--2 Sore.

विघ्नः [विहन्-क] (rarely n.)
1
An obstacle, interruption,
impediment, a hindrance; कुतो धर्मक्रियाविघ्नः
सतां रक्षितरि त्वयि Ś. 5. 14; मूर्तो
विघ्नस्तपस इव नः Ś. 1. 33; हुंकारेणेव धनुषः
स हि विघ्नानपोहति Ś. 3. 1; Ku. 3. 40.
--2 Difficulty, trouble.
--Comp.
--ईशः, --ईशानः, --ईश्वरः epithets of Gaṇeśa.
˚वाहनं a rat.
--कर, --कर्तृ, --कारिन् a.
opposing, obstructing.
--ध्वंसः,
--विघातः removal of obstacles.
--नायकः,
--नाशकः, --नाशनः epithets of Gaṇeśa.
--प्रतिक्रिया removal of impediments;
R. 15. 4.
--राजः --विनायकः, --हारिन्
m. epithets of Gaṇeśa.
--सिद्धिः f.
removal of obstacles.

विघ्नयति Den. P. To obstruct,
hinder, impede, oppose.

विघ्नित a.
1 Impeded, hindered,
obstructed, opposed; Pt. 1. 387.
--2 Obscured, blinded; Ku. 3. 31.
